description: This file defines a custom exception class CurrencyNotFoundException which extends a base exception class. It is used to signal that a currency with a specific code was not found in the system.
external_methods: super(String code, String defaultMessage, Object... args)

classes.name: CurrencyNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass representing the specific case where a currency could not be found based on a provided currency code.

methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a message indicating the invalid currency code.
